title: Pim and the Soft Snow
text:
The Moon is quiet. It’s a soft white light.
Pim the Turtle is slow and sleepy.
He sees the snow falling fast.

It’s falling in little flakes.
Each flake is a tiny grey dot.

Pim walks a little.
 He follows each flake.

They go down the hill.
 It makes a happy, quiet sound.

The snow is so soft and white.
Like a fluffy blanket.

Pim smiles, a very gentle smile.
He feels cozy and still.

The Moon shines softly.
It’s like a warm, quiet hug.

Pim starts to drift slowly.
He’s warm and comfy.
He’s already sleepy.

Sleep is coming...
